evidences.caption: A Maryland State Police cruiser sits at a blocked southbound entrance on the Baltimore-Washington Parkway that accesses the National Security Agency, Monday, March 30, 2015, in Fort Meade, Md. A senior U.S. official says preliminary reports from the scene at Fort Meade indicate one person is dead after a car with two people tried to ram a gate at the base. The official says a firefight ensued after the car tried to crash the gate, and at least one of the two people in the car is dead. Fort Meade is home of the National Security Agency.  (AP Photo/Patrick Semansky)
